history.name: Session search
history.cmd.cockpit: Context cockpit for the selected run
history.section.name: Session search
history.section.title: Session search and context cockpit
history.section.desc: Full-text search across every agent run (prompts, replies, tools, files, repository, role, model), and a per-run view of what the context holds.
history.section.enable: Enable session search and context cockpit
history.section.enableDesc: Off by default. While it is off nothing is indexed, loaded or shown; the index is built from the run logs when you first search.
history.section.enableAria: Enable session search and context cockpit
history.search.placeholder: Search prompts, replies, tools and files
history.field.title: Title
history.results: {n, plural, =0 {No runs} one {# run} other {# runs}}
history.indexed: {n, plural, one {# run indexed} other {# runs indexed}} in {ms} ms
history.empty.title: No matching runs
history.empty.desc: Try fewer words or clear a filter. A word also matches longer words that start with it.
history.none.title: No runs indexed yet
history.none.desc: Start a run and it shows up here. Older runs come from the event logs in the IDE data folder.
history.hint: All words must match. Put a phrase in quotes to match it exactly. Secrets are redacted before anything is indexed.
cockpit.name: Context
cockpit.empty.title: No run selected
cockpit.empty.desc: Pick a run in the Agents list to see what its context holds.
cockpit.expired.title: Transcript expired
cockpit.expired.desc: The event log of this run is gone, so its context can no longer be shown.
cockpit.windowAria: How full the context window is
cockpit.source.reported: Reported by the provider after the last turn.
cockpit.source.estimated: Estimated from the transcript text, about 4 characters per token. The provider has not reported usage yet.
cockpit.warn.contextHigh: The context window is {percent}% full. Consider a fresh run, or compact the conversation.
cockpit.warn.contextCritical: The context window is {percent}% full. The next turns may be compacted or fail.
cockpit.warn.repeatedReads: {path} was read {count} times in large chunks. Reading it once and keeping notes saves tokens.
cockpit.warn.noUsage: No usage reported yet. Token and cost numbers appear when the first turn ends.
cockpit.usage.title: Usage
cockpit.turns.title: Turns
cockpit.tools.title: Tools
cockpit.tools.note: Per-tool numbers are an estimate: each turn's tokens and cost are shared out by the size of the tool inputs and outputs.
cockpit.files.title: Files
cockpit.attachments.title: Attachments
cockpit.attachments.none: No attachments in this run's context.
night.name: Night queue
night.cmd.brief: Morning brief: what the night produced
night.section.name: Night queue
night.section.title: Night queue and Morning brief
night.section.desc: Prepare runs in the evening, let them go one at a time under their budgets, and read a brief the next morning. Nothing is ever committed or pushed.
night.section.enable: Enable the night queue and Morning brief
night.section.enableDesc: Off by default. While it is off nothing is loaded and the queue never starts a run.
night.section.enableAria: Enable the night queue and Morning brief
night.title: Tonight's queue
night.armedHint: The queue is on. The next run starts in a moment.
night.paused.battery: Paused: the Mac is on battery. The queue continues when it is plugged in.
night.paused.readOnly: Paused: the IDE is read-only, so no run may start.
night.empty.title: Nothing prepared yet
night.empty.desc: Add the runs you want done overnight. They start one at a time, each with its own time and token budget.
night.timeAria: Share of the time budget used
night.tokensAria: Share of the token budget used
night.reason.timeBudget: Stopped: the time budget ran out.
night.reason.tokenBudget: Stopped: the token budget ran out.
night.reason.interrupted: Interrupted: the app restarted or lost the run.
night.reason.noSafetyNet: Not started: a repository could not be snapshotted for Rewind.
night.add.capReached: A night holds {cap} runs at most
night.add.title: Add a run to tonight
night.add.promptPlaceholder: What should the agent do while you sleep?
night.err.promptTooLong: The prompt is too long (12,000 characters at most).
night.err.badMinutes: The time budget is 1 to 480 minutes.
night.err.badTokens: The token budget is 1,000 to 5,000,000 tokens.
night.err.nightCap: A night holds {cap} runs at most.
night.safety: Every run gets a Rewind snapshot first and runs one at a time. Nothing is committed or pushed; at most {cap} runs a night.
brief.title: Morning brief
brief.sub: Built on this Mac from the event logs and git. No model is used unless you ask.
brief.summarise.hint: Sends the facts below (titles, file names, counts, failure lines) to Haiku once
brief.summary.note: Written by Haiku from the facts below. Check the details in each run.
brief.note.noSnapshot: No Rewind snapshot, so no diff
brief.failed: {n, plural, one {# thing failed} other {# things failed}}
brief.needs: {n, plural, one {# item waits for you} other {# items wait for you}}
brief.need.question: Question
brief.empty.title: No runs to report
brief.empty.desc: Start the night queue, or run something by hand: the brief lists the runs of the last night.
brief.footer: Costs are the provider's own estimates and are left out when a run reported none. Nothing was committed or pushed.
